crossRefs.note: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?
“Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by…
Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?
Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunder storm,

translations.web: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
translations.bsb: Do you know how God dispatches the clouds or makes the lightning flash?
translations.kjv: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?
translations.asv: Dost thou know how God layeth his charge upon them, And causeth the lightning of his cloud to shine?
